references.title: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services

knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=azure`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services (`Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`, Splunkbase 3110) with the modular input for `azure:monitor:activity`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.2.58.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `operationName` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Enable Azure Activity Log and Entra audit export to Event Hub or Storage; configure `Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices` modular inputs into `index=azure`. Tune exclusions for documented automation service principals.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=azure sourcetype="azure:monitor:activity" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=azure sourcetype="azure:monitor:activity" (operationName="Add member to role" OR operationName="Add eligible member to role")
| table _time operationName caller resourceId resultType
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.2.86_azure_entra_id_privilege_86"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `azure:monitor:activity` in `index=azure` to detect azure entra id privileged role assignment. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the Azure portal Activity Log blade for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `operationName` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_2_86_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Events list, timeline by operationName, table of caller and resourceId..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services (`Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices`, Splunkbase 3110) and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
